concept.prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Create one large readable premium frontend design specification board, landscape 3:2. Two coordinated columns for an existing cinematic illustrated character archive, left YOON / Korean Breathing WATER theme, right KUBA / Polish Breathing FLAME theme. This is a component restyle of an existing serif artbook website, not a new information architecture. Both columns must show the same component families clearly at usable readable scale: (1) top two character navigation tabs Yoon and Kuba plus section tabs Character, Their Story, The Breathing, Twelve Forms, Gallery; (2) elegant large Cormorant-like serif character name, subtitle and one primary filled CTA 'Explore the twelve forms' with arrow and a secondary outlined button 'Meet Yoon' or 'Meet Kuba'; (3) close-up horizontal form artwork card frame with numbered form chip, delicate border and compact 'Character study' toggle and circular expand icon; (4) gallery control buttons previous/next and one portrait card caption. Existing visual language: dark navy and ivory, refined editorial typesetting, ample spacing. WATER column: translucent midnight teal glass, luminous pale aqua edges, delicate ripple arcs, clear cool aqua filled primary button with dark navy label, rounded 10px UI corners, layered subtle watery gradients, glints of silver; white readable body and UI text. FLAME column: dark obsidian burgundy glass, crisp copper/gold borders, amber to ember gradient primary button with dark readable label, elegant 5px slightly angular corners, sparse ember specks, gentle warm glow. Keep controls tangible, high contrast and coherent, no excessive neon, no generic dashboard, no overdecorated shapes, no fake metrics, no extra content, no badges above hero title. Deep continuous editorial canvas with clearly presented component states (hover/current) and artwork areas using abstract water flow / flame brushstroke vignettes only, not new character drawings. Must be implementable as native CSS gradients, SVG ornaments, semantic buttons and cards. No browser chrome or watermark. Art direction polished, calm aquatic versus controlled fiery energy, same quality and family across both sides.

landscape.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. ONE wide cinematic environmental texture for a premium Polish Breathing character artbook website. No characters, text, symbols, logo or border. Near-black obsidian and deep burgundy atmospheric space, very dark empty upper and left two thirds for readable website text. In the lower right third, elegant sharp sweeping ribbons of crimson fire with molten gold edges and sparse tiny rising amber embers. Subtle charcoal rocky ground, dim heat haze and smoky layered depth. Restrained sophisticated painterly anime environment, luminous fine detail in the flame edges but NOT a wall of fire, NOT a bright orange background, no explosion, no buildings or landmarks. Flame accents arc naturally upward from the bottom right edge like a controlled sabre wake. Frame landscape 16:9, dark edges blend into #180e12.
